speaker: lord-god
text: I am the Alpha and the Omega,
name: The Lord God

speaker: jesus
text: Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore write down the things you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits. Yet you have held fast to My name and have not denied your faith in Me, even in the day when My faithful witness Antipas was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I know your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance—and your latter deeds are greater than your first.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nevertheless, hold fast to what you have until I come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery—just as I have received authority from My Father.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And I will give him the morning star.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which was about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Remember, then, what you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when I will come upon you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. For you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look at those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead. I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Those I love, I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.
name: Jesus

speaker: creatures
text: Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!
name: The four living creatures

speaker: elders
text: Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and came to be.
name: The twenty-four elders

speaker: angel
text: Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?
name: A mighty angel

speaker: elder
text: Do not weep! Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.
name: One of the elders

speaker: elders-creatures
text: Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
name: The living creatures and the elders

speaker: elders-creatures
text: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign upon the earth.
name: The living creatures and the elders

speaker: angels
text: Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!
name: The angels

speaker: creation
text: To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!
name: Every creature

speaker: creatures
text: Amen,
name: The four living creatures

speaker: creatures
text: Come!
name: The four living creatures

speaker: creatures
text: Come!
name: The four living creatures

speaker: creatures
text: Come!
name: The four living creatures

speaker: creatures
text: A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine.
name: The four living creatures

speaker: creatures
text: Come!
name: The four living creatures

speaker: martyrs
text: How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You avenge our blood and judge those who dwell upon the earth?
name: The martyrs under the altar

speaker: earth-people
text: Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb.
name: The people of the earth

speaker: earth-people
text: For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?
name: The people of the earth

speaker: angel
text: Do not harm the land or sea or trees until we have sealed the foreheads of the servants of our God.
name: A mighty angel

speaker: multitude
text: Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!
name: The great multitude

speaker: angels
text: Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.
name: The angels

speaker: elder
text: These in white robes,
name: One of the elders

speaker: elder
text: who are they, and where have they come from?
name: One of the elders

speaker: john
text: Sir,
name: John

speaker: john
text: you know.
name: John

speaker: elder
text: These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
name: One of the elders

speaker: elder
text: For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
name: One of the elders

speaker: elder
text: ‘Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat.’
name: One of the elders

speaker: elder
text: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’
name: One of the elders

speaker: eagle
text: Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!
name: An eagle

speaker: voice-altar
text: Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.
name: A voice from the altar

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: angel
text: There will be no more delay!
name: A mighty angel

speaker: angel
text: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.
name: A mighty angel

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: john
text: Give me the small scroll.
name: John

speaker: angel
text: Take it and eat it,
name: A mighty angel

speaker: angel
text: It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.
name: A mighty angel

speaker: voices
text: You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.
name: The heavenly voices

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-heaven
text: But exclude the courtyard outside the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-heaven
text: And I will empower my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Come up here.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: heaven-voices
text: The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.
name: Loud voices in heaven

speaker: elders
text: We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
name: The twenty-four elders

speaker: elders
text: The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great— and to destroy those who destroy the earth.
name: The twenty-four elders

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down— he who accuses them day and night before our God.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-heaven
text: They have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. And they did not love their lives so as to shy away from death.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea; with great fury the devil has come down to you, knowing he has only a short time.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: worshippers
text: Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?
name: The beast's worshippers

speaker: angel1
text: Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.
name: The first angel

speaker: angel2
text: Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who has made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.
name: The second angel

speaker: angel3
text: If anyone worships the beast and its image, and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,
name: The third angel

speaker: angel3
text: he too will drink the wine of God’s anger, poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath. And he will be tormented in fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
name: The third angel

speaker: angel3
text: And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever. Day and night there is no rest for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.
name: The third angel

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Blessed are the dead—those who die in the Lord from this moment on.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: spirit
text: Yes,
name: The Spirit

speaker: spirit
text: they will rest from their labors, for their deeds will follow them.
name: The Spirit

speaker: angel-temple
text: Swing Your sickle and reap, because the time has come to harvest; for the crop of the earth is ripe.
name: An angel from the temple

speaker: angel-fire
text: Swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.
name: The angel over the fire

speaker: victors
text: Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
name: Those victorious over the beast

speaker: victors
text: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.
name: Those victorious over the beast

speaker: voice-temple
text: Go, pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God’s wrath.
name: A voice from the temple

speaker: angel-waters
text: Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.
name: The angel of the waters

speaker: angel-waters
text: For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink, as they deserve.
name: The angel of the waters

speaker: altar
text: Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are Your judgments.
name: The altar

speaker: jesus
text: Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who remains awake and clothed, so that he will not go naked and let his shame be exposed.
name: Jesus

speaker: voice-temple
text: It is done!
name: A voice from the temple

speaker: angel-bowl
text: Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and those who dwell on the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her immorality.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: Why are you so amazed?
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: The beast that you saw—it was, and now is no more, but is about to come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. And those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king, who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings, along with the beast.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: And the ten horns and the beast that you saw will hate the prostitute. They will leave her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-bowl
text: And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-glory
text: Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a lair for demons and a haunt for every unclean spirit, every unclean bird, and every detestable beast.
name: An angel with great authority

speaker: angel-glory
text: All the nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her immorality. The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown wealthy from the extravagance of her luxury.
name: An angel with great authority

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Come out of her, My people, so that you will not share in her sins or contract any of her plagues.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-heaven
text: For her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Give back to her as she has done to others; pay her back double for what she has done; mix her a double portion in her own cup.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-heaven
text: As much as she has glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her the same measure of torment and grief. In her heart she says, ‘I sit as queen; I am not a widow and will never see grief.’
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-heaven
text: Therefore her plagues will come in one day— death and grief and famine— and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: kings
text: Woe, woe to the great city, the mighty city of Babylon! For in a single hour your judgment has come.
name: The kings of the earth

speaker: merchants
text: The fruit of your soul’s desire has departed from you; all your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be seen again.
name: The merchants

speaker: merchants
text: Woe, woe to the great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!
name: The merchants

speaker: merchants
text: For in a single hour such fabulous wealth has been destroyed!
name: The merchants

speaker: sailors
text: What city was ever like this great city?
name: The sea captains and sailors

speaker: sailors
text: Woe, woe to the great city, where all who had ships on the sea were enriched by her wealth! For in a single hour she has been destroyed.
name: The sea captains and sailors

speaker: mighty-angel
text: With such violence the great city of Babylon will be cast down, never to be seen again.
name: A mighty angel

speaker: mighty-angel
text: And the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will never ring out in you again. Nor will any craftsmen of any trade be found in you again, nor the sound of a millstone be heard in you again.
name: A mighty angel

speaker: mighty-angel
text: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voices of a bride and bridegroom will never call out in you again. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.
name: A mighty angel

speaker: multitude
text: Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
name: The great multitude

speaker: multitude
text: For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.
name: The great multitude

speaker: multitude
text: Hallelujah! Her smoke rises forever and ever.
name: The great multitude

speaker: elders-creatures
text: Amen, Hallelujah!
name: The living creatures and the elders

speaker: voice-throne
text: Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!
name: A voice from the throne

speaker: multitude
text: Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
name: The great multitude

speaker: multitude
text: Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
name: The great multitude

speaker: multitude
text: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.
name: The great multitude

speaker: angel-guide
text: Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.
name: The angel

speaker: angel-guide
text: These are the true words of God.
name: The angel

speaker: angel-guide
text: Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
name: The angel

speaker: angel-sun
text: Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
name: An angel standing in the sun

speaker: angel-sun
text: so that you may eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men, of horses and riders, of everyone slave and free, small and great.
name: An angel standing in the sun

speaker: voice-throne
text: Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.
name: A voice from the throne

speaker: voice-throne
text: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.
name: A voice from the throne

speaker: god
text: Behold, I make all things new.
name: The One seated on the throne

speaker: god
text: Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.
name: The One seated on the throne

speaker: god
text: It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.
name: The One seated on the throne

speaker: god
text: The one who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son.
name: The One seated on the throne

speaker: god
text: But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.
name: The One seated on the throne

speaker: angel-bowl
text: Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.
name: One of the seven bowl angels

speaker: angel-guide
text: These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.
name: The angel

speaker: jesus
text: Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book.
name: Jesus

speaker: angel-guide
text: Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!
name: The angel

speaker: angel-guide
text: Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
name: The angel

speaker: angel-guide
text: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.
name: The angel

speaker: jesus
text: Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.
name: Jesus

speaker: spirit-bride
text: Come!
name: The Spirit and the bride

speaker: jesus
text: Yes, I am coming soon.
name: Jesus
